title: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: 近年来，中国政府高度重视民营经济(private economy)的发展，出台了一系列政策支持民营企业。截至 2025 年 3 月底，全国民营企业数量超过 5700 万家，占企业总量的 92.3%。民营企业不仅数量稳步增长，质量和结构也在不断提升。民营企业的研发投入不断增加，在新一代信息技术、人工智能等领域发展迅速。民营企业核心竞争力的增强为中国经济的高质量发展提供了有力支撑。
reference: In recent years, the Chinese government has attached great importance to the development of the private economy and introduced a series of policies to support private enterprises. By the end of March 2025, the number of private enterprises nationwide exceeded 57 million, accounting for 92.3% of the total number of enterprises. Private enterprises are not only growing steadily in number but also improving in quality and structure. They are also increasing their R&D investment and developing rapidly in fields such as next-generation information technology and artificial intelligence. As a result, the enhancement of private enterprises' core competitiveness provides strong support for the high-quality development of China's economy.
